entities.summary: Soleimani, a notable figure in the history of Iran, associated with Post-War Islamic Republic and Nuclear Crisis (2018–2025). Preceded by Green Movement protests erupt after disputed presidential election and JCPOA nuclear agreement signed between Iran and P5+1. Their legacy influenced US assassinates IRGC General Qasem Soleimani in Baghdad and Mahsa Amini protests — 'Woman, Life, Freedom' movement sweeps Iran.
